claims.evidence: Witness report shows an engine assembly on a stand with hoses/piping; no readable paperwork/guarantee terms or origin markings are visible.
Witness report notes labels/markings but they are not clearly readable; no origin documents or clearly readable markings are shown.
Witness report does not include any start-up video, compression test, or running condition observations.
No audio/video of the engine running is included in the witness observations.
Mileage/usage history is explicitly not shown/readable in the witness report.
No evidence of disassembly/fastener tampering is shown; witness cannot confirm internal condition from the single photo.

risks.risk: Engine make/model and configuration are not readable, so compatibility and correct pricing are uncertain (could be wrong engine for the buyer’s application).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the engine ID/plate and casting numbers (and/or a photo showing the full engine label with readable text).
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unidentified used engine assembly with unknown compatibility.

risks.risk: Whether it actually runs/was tested is unknown; internal damage (bore/scoring/valvetrain) may not be visible in a static photo.
risks.proof: A short start-up video showing the engine running smoothly (idle), plus a compression test sheet or mechanic test result.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst-case: needs overhaul).

risks.risk: Turbo/large intake duct presence suggests forced induction; turbo failure or oil feed/return issues can be costly and not visible externally.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the turbo (shaft play check if possible) and a video of boost/idle behavior; also show oil/coolant lines condition.

risks.risk: Missing/unknown accessories and parts condition (belts, alternator, starter, sensors) could make the engine unusable without extra spend.
risks.proof: A complete parts inventory photo/clip: alternator, starter, sensors, belts, hoses, and any included wiring harnesses—clearly shown.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming accessories may be missing or worn.

risks.risk: Leak/seal/gasket condition is unknown (oil/coolant leaks, head gasket issues). Static photos may not reveal seepage.
risks.proof: Photos of the engine after running (or a leak check) showing no wetness around gaskets, plus close-ups of sump/head areas.

risks.risk: Transmission/gearbox compatibility is unknown if the assembly is intended to be paired with a specific gearbox.
risks.proof: If gearbox is included: photo of gearbox model/plate and mounting interface; if not included: confirm explicitly what is included.
risks.if_unproven: Price as engine-only with unknown pairing requirements.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photos of the engine ID plate/casting numbers (readable) to confirm make/model and configuration.
A start-up video (engine running) and/or compression test results (sheet or clear photos).
Photos/clip of the turbo and intake/exhaust connections, including any oil feed/return lines.
A full inventory photo showing all included accessories (alternator, starter, sensors, belts, wiring harness) and what is missing.
Photos of the engine after running or a leak-check showing gasket/seal condition (no wetness around head/sump).
Confirm exactly what is included (engine only vs engine + transmission/gearbox) and show gearbox plate if included.
response.reason: The witness can identify it as a used internal combustion engine assembly, so it can be priced at its worst case; however, running/test, origin, mileage, and exact model are not verifiable from the report, so it must be treated as unknown/possibly not working until proven.
